description: The file is a shell script named 'pr_cycle.sh' that manages the review lifecycle for components in a project. It provides commands to start, stop, and clear review cycles by updating specific metadata in YAML files, and includes helper functions for date calculations and listing components.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds and lists all component directories by locating 'metadata.yaml' files.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays the help message with usage instructions.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the path to a component's 'metadata.yaml' file, with error handling.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a date offset by a given number of business days, skipping weekends.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Removes review lifecycle date entries from a 'metadata.yaml' file.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Calls an external script to regenerate the RAG status report.
